source.english_context: Unit 03 Housing and Renting Goal: rent a room or apartment, ask about costs, and understand house rules. Daily Life English How much is the rent each month? Is the deposit refundable? Are utilities included? Can I see the lease before I sign? When can I move in? How long is the lease? Is the apartment furnished? Is there a laundry room in the building? Are pets allowed? Where can I park my car? How do I request a repair? What are the quiet hours? Can you send me the rental terms in writing? How much notice should I give before moving out? Can I schedule a time to see the apartment? Vocabulary rent money you pay to live in a place lease a rental contract deposit money paid before moving in landlord the person or company that owns the rental tenant the person who rents the place roommate a person who lives in the same home utilities home services such as water, electricity, and gas furnished provided with furniture move-in date the day you can start living in a new home notice information given ahead of a change or event rental application a form used to request permission to rent a home quiet hours times when residents are asked to keep noise low US Customs Read the lease before you sign. Ask questions in writing. Take photos when you move in. Keep proof of damage you did not make. Quiet hours, guest rules, parking, pets, and trash rules are common. Ask which costs are included in the rent and which you pay separately. Request the details before making plans. Roommates may share kitchen and bathroom space. Talk about cleaning, visitors, and shared supplies before problems become frustrating. Check how to contact the landlord or manager for routine repairs, and ask which number handles urgent building problems. Before moving out, ask about the building's checkout process, key return, and inspection. Keep the written instructions for reference. Dialogue Student: Is this room still available? Landlord: Yes. The rent is $850 a month. Student: Are utilities included? Landlord: Water is included. Electricity is separate. Student: Can I review the lease tonight? Landlord: Of course. I can email you a copy. Student: Are there rules about guests and quiet hours? Landlord: Yes. They are listed on the second page. Student: Thank you. I will read it and send you my questions. Landlord: That is fine. Let me know if anything is unclear.

japanese_explanation.heading: 契約前に確認すること
points: 家賃だけでなく、保証金、光熱費、駐車場、洗濯、ペット、解約条件も確認します。英語が難しければ、署名前に時間をもらいましょう。
アメリカでは書面の記録が大切です。質問、修理依頼、支払いの証拠はメールや写真で残すと安心です。
ルームメイトと住む場合は、掃除、静かな時間、来客、共有品のルールを早めに話します。
japanese_explanation.practice: Can I see the lease before I sign?

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 签约前要确认的事
points: 不要只看房租。还要确认押金、水电费、停车、洗衣、宠物和提前搬走的规则。如果英文难，签字前可以要求时间阅读。
在美国，书面记录很重要。问题、维修请求和付款证明最好用邮件、短信或照片保存。
如果和室友同住，要早点说清楚打扫、安静时间、客人和公共用品的规则。
existing_simplified_chinese.practice: Can I see the lease before I sign?

ja.heading: 契約前に確認すること
points: 家賃だけでなく、保証金、光熱費、駐車場、洗濯、ペット、解約条件も確認します。英語が難しければ、署名前に時間をもらいましょう。
アメリカでは書面の記録が大切です。質問、修理依頼、支払いの証拠はメールや写真で残すと安心です。
ルームメイトと住む場合は、掃除、静かな時間、来客、共有品のルールを早めに話します。

ko.heading: 계약 전 확인 사항
points: 월세뿐 아니라 보증금, 공과금, 주차, 세탁, 반려동물, 계약 해지 조건도 확인하세요. 영어가 어렵다면 서명하기 전에 시간을 달라고 요청하세요.
미국에서는 서면 기록이 중요합니다. 질문, 수리 요청, 지불 증거를 이메일이나 사진으로 남겨두면 안전합니다.
룸메이트와 함께 살 경우, 청소, 조용한 시간, 손님, 공용 물품 규칙에 대해 미리 논의하세요.

zh-Hans.heading: 签约前要确认的事项
points: 不只要确认房租，还要确认押金、水电费、停车、洗衣、宠物和解约条件。如果英文有困难，可以在签字前要求时间阅读。
在美国，书面记录非常重要。通过电子邮件或照片保留问题、维修请求和付款证明是稳妥的做法。
如果和室友同住，要尽早讨论清楚打扫、安静时间、访客和共享物品的规则。

es.heading: Qué revisar antes de firmar el contrato
points: No solo confirme el alquiler, sino también el depósito, los servicios públicos, el estacionamiento, la lavandería, las mascotas y las condiciones de cancelación. Si el inglés le resulta difícil, pida tiempo antes de firmar.
En Estados Unidos, los registros escritos son importantes. Conviene guardar un registro de las preguntas, las solicitudes de reparación y los pagos mediante correos electrónicos o fotografías.
Si vive con compañeros de piso, hable con antelación sobre las normas de limpieza, las horas de silencio, las visitas y los artículos compartidos.

pt-BR.heading: O que verificar antes de assinar o contrato
points: Não verifique apenas o aluguel, mas também o depósito, as contas de consumo, estacionamento, lavanderia, animais de estimação e as condições de rescisão. Se o inglês for difícil, peça tempo antes de assinar.
Nos EUA, registros escritos são importantes. É mais seguro manter provas de perguntas, pedidos de reparo e pagamentos por e-mail ou fotos.
Se for morar com colegas de quarto, discuta as regras de limpeza, horários de silêncio, visitas e itens compartilhados com antecedência.

fr.heading: Ce qu'il faut vérifier avant de signer le contrat
points: Vérifiez non seulement le loyer, mais aussi le dépôt de garantie, les charges, le stationnement, la buanderie, les animaux de compagnie et les conditions de résiliation. Si l'anglais est difficile pour vous, demandez du temps avant de signer.
Aux États-Unis, les documents écrits sont importants. Il est prudent de conserver des preuves des questions posées, des demandes de réparation et des paiements par e-mail ou par photo.
Si vous vivez en colocation, discutez des règles de nettoyage, des heures de silence, des invités et des articles partagés dès le début.

de.heading: Was Sie vor Vertragsunterzeichnung überprüfen sollten
points: Klären Sie nicht nur die Miete, sondern auch die Kaution, die Nebenkosten, Parkmöglichkeiten, Wäsche, Haustiere und die Kündigungsbedingungen. Wenn Ihnen Englisch schwerfällt, bitten Sie vor der Unterschrift um Bedenkzeit.
In den USA sind schriftliche Aufzeichnungen wichtig. Es ist ratsam, Nachweise für Fragen, Reparaturanfragen und Zahlungen per E-Mail oder Fotos aufzubewahren.
Wenn Sie mit Mitbewohnern zusammenleben, besprechen Sie frühzeitig die Regeln für Sauberkeit, Ruhezeiten, Besucher und gemeinsam genutzte Gegenstände.
